# Mariagerfjord

Mariagerfjord is a Danish municipality (kommune) named once in the corpus as part of "Klynge SYD," one of the geographic health clusters participating in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark) [^src1]. The mention appears within a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse / structured patient education) for atrial fibrillation care, which includes a geographic overview of Danish health clusters taking part in the program [^src1]. No further details about Mariagerfjord's role, population, or specific contributions to the program are available in the corpus.
